Twin Reunion

By: Busisiwe Gumede | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
An incredible reunion of twins who were separated after a decade apart. Despite being robbed of a life together, they are grateful and excited for what lies ahead.

Unique Selling Point:
Imagine knowing you were born with a twin but not knowing where they
are or whether or not they are still alive. That’s the story of Boitumelo and
Tumelo who are now 20 years old. Separated in 2013 when their parents
died in a tragic car accident, Tumi and Boitumelo were taken and raised
by different families. Boitumelo says she was brought up in an abusive
environment, with relatives who were related to her but didn't treat her
accordingly. She says they took advantage of the fact that her parents
and brother were gone and was made to grow up quickly, making her do
chores and being subjected to physical abuse.Being separated from her
twin brother affected her significantly. She would have nightmares over it
and it made her feel incredibly alone in a home with people who felt like
strangers to her. She says, even from a young age, she and her brother
shared a unique bond - from their mannerisms, their ability to finish each
other’s sentences and what she calls a “magical connection” that they
used to share.
Ten years apart from each other also affected Tumelo. His
circumstances were a lot harder than her sister, physically. He was living
in a shack in town and struggling financially. The family that took him in
also abused him and he fell into a life of drugs. He struggled to get a job,
felt unloved and wanted to take the pain away with smoking drugs.
Despite his addiction he had access to facebook. Contemplating suicide,
he one day received a facebook message from his long lost sister.
Although they weren’t using the same surnames as usernames,
Boitumelo said that she occasionally searched people with Tumelo as
their usernames. She also admits that it took long for them to find each
other on facebook largely because her brother would lose phones from
time to time.

Summary:
On the day of their reunion, Boitumelo captured the encounter through
cellphone video which she later posted on tiktok. Since then the video
trended and gained over two million views, 1.8 million likes and more
than 50 000 comments within three days since it was uploaded. In the
video, the TikTokker can be seen interacting with her twin brother for a
short while before she wraps her arms around him. It’s unknown why or
how the twins were separated from each other, however, what is evident
is that they lived two different lives.
While Boitumelo is seen dressed clean and put together in her cute outfit,
it was obvious that her twin brother had been struggling to make ends
meet. Nonetheless, the strong bond between the twins was the star of
the clip. When the duo finally embraced each other, they had TikTok
users weeping in the comment section.
The big story about this is that both their lives changed for the better.
Tumelo underwent a new journey of being clean. His twin sister helped
him get into a rehab facility and he finished the six month course. They
see each other often. Her wish is for her brother to get himself a job and
stay clean.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): An incredible reunion of twins who were separated after a decade apart. Despite being robbed of a life together, they are grateful and excited for what lies ahead.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Imagine knowing you were born with a twin but not knowing where they are or whether or not they are still alive. That’s the story of Boitumelo and Tumelo who are now 20 years old. Separated in 2013 when their parents died in a tragic car accident, Tumi and Boitumelo were taken and raised by different families. Boitumelo says she was brought up in an abusive environment, with relatives who were related to her but didn't treat her accordingly. She says they took advantage of the fact that her parents and brother were gone and was made to grow up quickly, making her do chores and being subjected to physical abuse.Being separated from her twin brother affected her significantly. She would have nightmares over it and it made her feel incredibly alone in a home with people who felt like strangers to her. She says, even from a young age, she and her brother shared a unique bond - from their mannerisms, their ability to finish each other’s sentences and what she calls a “magical connection” that they used to share. Ten years apart from each other also affected Tumelo. His circumstances were a lot harder than her sister, physically. He was living in a shack in town and struggling financially. The family that took him in also abused him and he fell into a life of drugs. He struggled to get a job, felt unloved and wanted to take the pain away with smoking drugs. Despite his addiction he had access to facebook. Contemplating suicide, he one day received a facebook message from his long lost sister. Although they weren’t using the same surnames as usernames, Boitumelo said that she occasionally searched people with Tumelo as their usernames. She also admits that it took long for them to find each other on facebook largely because her brother would lose phones from time to time.
metadata.Summary: On the day of their reunion, Boitumelo captured the encounter through cellphone video which she later posted on tiktok. Since then the video trended and gained over two million views, 1.8 million likes and more than 50 000 comments within three days since it was uploaded. In the video, the TikTokker can be seen interacting with her twin brother for a short while before she wraps her arms around him. It’s unknown why or how the twins were separated from each other, however, what is evident is that they lived two different lives. While Boitumelo is seen dressed clean and put together in her cute outfit, it was obvious that her twin brother had been struggling to make ends meet. Nonetheless, the strong bond between the twins was the star of the clip. When the duo finally embraced each other, they had TikTok users weeping in the comment section. The big story about this is that both their lives changed for the better. Tumelo underwent a new journey of being clean. His twin sister helped him get into a rehab facility and he finished the six month course. They see each other often. Her wish is for her brother to get himself a job and stay clean.
